{"zh":"# 六边形消除 (Hexa Puzzle) 终极通关宝典与消除技巧全书 欢迎来到 Puzzle PK 官方六边形消除高阶攻略指南！六边形消除是一款结合了经典积木拼放与神奇蜂窝几何的现代益智游戏。与传统的四四方方的俄罗斯方块不同，正六边形拥有多达 3 个方向的消除轴线。本教程将带你从最基础的蜂窝格子数起，深入剖析不旋转积木的拼放秘诀、空间管理四大法则、三向交织爆炸大招，以及多人实时对决中的生存取胜心法！ --- ## 第一章：蜂窝棋盘的奥秘：为什么正好是 61 个格子？ ### 1.1 蜂窝的格子是怎么数出来的？小学生也能心算！ 整个棋盘由很多个正六边形组成，从最中心的一颗像水波纹一样一圈圈向外扩散： - **最中心**：只有 1 个核心格子； - **第 1 圈（紧贴中心）**：一圈共有 6 个格子； - **第 2 圈**：共有 12 个格子； - **第 3 圈**：共有 18 个格子； - **第 4 圈（最外层边界）**：共有 24 个格子； 我们把每一圈加在一起： ```text 1 + 6 + 12 + 18 + 24 = 61 个格子！ ``` 是不是一目了然？整个棋盘正好由这 61 个精巧的正六边形严丝合缝地拼接而成。 ### 1.2 三大消除轴线与 27 条消除轨道
蜂窝 61 格全景与三大消除轴交互示意图
轴 1：水平横向（9条） 轴 2：左斜 60度（9条） 轴 3：右斜 120度（9条） 枢纽：中心交织引爆点
在六边形里，只要填满以下任意一条线，整条线就会瞬间消除： 1. **水平横线**：共 9 条轨道； 2. **左斜 60 度线**：共 9 条轨道； 3. **右斜 120 度线**：共 9 条轨道； 加起来一共有整整 **27 条可以消除的道路**！最靠边的一条线只有 5 格长，而穿过正中心的最长线足足有 9 格长！ --- ## 第二章：积木为什么不能旋转？怎样管理不同形状？ 很多刚玩的小伙伴会问：“为什么游戏不给一个旋转按钮呢？” - **原因其实很简单**：如果可以随意旋转，只要快装不下时转一圈就能塞进去，游戏就没有任何挑战性了！ - **不旋转的设计**：强迫大家在脑海里像玩拼图一样，提前观察空隙，给积木安排最舒适的安放角度。 ### 积木危险度排行榜： - **S 级（万能救火神石）**： - **单格六边形**：全场最珍贵的宝物，能无视任何阻挡，填补任何狭小的小孔，或者触发临门一脚的消除！ - **双联骨牌**：两颗连在一起，怎么放都很灵活。 - **A 级（长条冲锋枪）**： - **3 连条与 4 连条**：一条线直接填满半边天，打出消除非常爽，但如果缺少长跑道容易卡手。 - **C 级（高危致命大块）**： - **大三角形与大菱形**：占地面积特别大。如果棋盘正中间被杂乱的小块占满，大三角形就会无处落脚，直接导致猝不及防的 Game Over！ --- ## 第三章：绝不暴毙的“空间管理四大法则” 想玩到一万分以上，这四句法则一定要牢记在心： ### 法则 1：中心圣地永远保持通透！ 很多新手习惯把积木往棋盘正正中间放，觉得中间最宽敞。**这是最致命的习惯！** 把大块放在正中间，会一下把横向、左斜、右斜三条跨越全盘的核心长线全部堵死，整张大棋盘立刻被切碎成了几个孤立的小角落。 **正确做法**：大块往外围靠，中间永远留出空地！ ### 法则 2：靠边贴放，填平凹槽 把大块顺着外围边缘贴平，就像砌墙一样，把凹凸不平的地方填成平整的边缘，绝不留下只有 1 个格子的“死胡同”。 ### 法则 3：三块统筹，看三步走一步！ 游戏每次会在下方给你准备 3 个积木。放第一个积木之前，**先花 2 秒钟扫一眼全部 3 个积木**： - 哪个块头最大最难放？ - 棋盘上有没有地方能装得下它？ - 优先保证大块有地方落脚，再放小块！ ### 法则 4：危险预警红线 棋盘一共 61 格。如果棋盘上已经堆了超过 40 个格子（占满了三分之二），必须立刻停止“憋大招”，只要能消一行就马上消一行，先求生存，把格子腾出来再说！ --- ## 第四章：高手是怎么打出上万分的？多线同消大爆炸！ 为什么高手玩一把动辄几万分，而新手只能拿一两千分？秘密就在于**“一次消除多条线”**的超高暴击奖励： ```text ★ 消除 1 条线：基础分 100 分 ★ 消除 2 条线：基础分 350 分（相当于单消的 3.5 倍！） ★ 消除 3 条线：基础分 900 分（相当于单消的 9 倍！！） ★ 消除 4 条线：基础分 2,000 分（相当于单消的 20 倍！！！） ``` 达成一次 4 线同消拿到的分数，抵得上辛辛苦苦单线消除 20 次！ 想要打出 3 线同消，秘诀就是找到像雪花中心一样的**“交叉枢纽点”**：让横线、左斜线、右斜线都只差同一个中心格子，最后把单颗积木往中心一拍，三条线在同一瞬间全部轰然爆炸清空！ --- ## 第五章：连击（Combo）乘数表与小火慢炖 只要每次放置积木都能触发消除，顶部的连击计数就会一直往上跳，分数乘数会越来越夸张： - 1 连击：1.0 倍 - 2 连击：1.5 倍 - 3 连击：2.0 倍 - 4 连击：2.5 倍 - **5 连击以上：直接翻 3.0 倍甚至 5.0 倍！** 在 4 连击的状态下如果消掉两条线，得分会直接暴增为 `350 × 2.5 = 875 分`！高手都会故意把好几条线留着“差一格”，然后像点燃导火索一样接连不断地引爆！ --- ## 第六章：多人实时对战（PvP）生存秘籍 在多人对决房间里，大家拿到的积木掉落顺序是完全一模一样的： 1. **开局抢攻**：前 15 步棋盘还很空的时候，用最快的手速连续做出双线消除，把比分迅速拉开到 2000 分以上，让对手慌神； 2. **中后期比拼耐心**：到后面棋盘变挤时，不要贪图做大招，谁能多活过两轮大三角形积木，谁就能稳稳拿下比赛胜利！ --- ## 第七章：常见疑问解答 (FAQ) ### Q1: 手机屏幕上单指拖拽时，手指会挡住下方的格子怎么办？ 答：不用担心！Puzzle PK 专门设计了**“手指视差悬浮”**功能：当你在手机屏幕上按住积木拖动时，积木会自动向上悬浮一小段距离，露出你指尖下方的视野。只要看屏幕上方出现的半透明白色虚影对齐了格子，松开手指就会精准吸附落位！ ### Q2: 为什么某条线看起来填满了，系统却没有消除？ 答：六边形消除要求必须**从棋盘的一端外边缘一直通到另一端外边缘**。如果中途有一格漏掉了，或者看错了倾斜的方向，是不能触发消除的。仔细沿着一条直线看过去，确保整条线上的每一个格子都有积木！ ### Q3: 棋盘能全部清空吗？全清有什么奖励？ 答：能！在开局前几步或者经过绝妙的多线同消，可以把棋盘上的 61 个格子全部清空。一旦达成“全盘清空 (All Clear)”，系统会立刻额外赠送你 **+1,500 分** 的超级成就大奖！ ","en":"# The Definitive Guide to Hexa Puzzle: Honeycomb Geometry & Multidimensional Line Clearing Welcome to the official, authoritative master strategy guide for **Hexa Puzzle** on Puzzle PK. Beyond its surface reputation as a casual, stress-relieving brain teaser, Hexa Puzzle represents one of the most intellectually satisfying intersections of discrete mathematics, non-Euclidean regular tiling, and dynamic spatial resource management. Unlike orthogonal square-grid games (such as Tetris, 1010, or Block Puzzle), a regular hexagonal lattice possesses isotropic symmetry with **three distinct elimination axes**. This masterclass provides an exhaustive curriculum—spanning cube coordinate geometry, unrotatable polyhex topology, the Four Axioms of Space Management, multi-line intersection traps, and competitive PvP survival dynamics. --- ## Chapter 1: Honeycomb Geometry & Cube Coordinate Mechanics ### 1.1 The Mathematical Elegance of Hexagonal Tiling In Euclidean plane geometry, exactly three regular polygons can form a monohedral regular tiling: equilateral triangles $\{3, 6\}$, squares $\{4, 4\}$, and regular hexagons $\{6, 3\}$. Among these, the regular hexagon achieves the **optimal perimeter-to-area ratio (isoperimetric quotient)** and perfect isotropic edge-sharing: every single cell shares an identical boundary with exactly 6 immediate neighbors, completely eliminating the corner-point singularities found in square grids. ### 1.2 Cube Coordinates $(q, r, s)$ on a Radius-4 Grid To rigorously govern piece placement, line scanning, and collision detection, the Hexa engine utilizes three-dimensional **Cube Coordinates**: $$q + r + s = 0$$ Every cell on the board corresponds to a unique integer triplet satisfying this constraint. - For our standard board with radius $R = 4$, the total number of cells is derived via the hexagonal centered triangular number formula: $$N(R) = 1 + 3R(R + 1) = 1 + 3(4)(5) = 61 \text{ cells}$$ ### 1.3 The 3 Elimination Axes and 27 Traversal Tracks
61-Cell Honeycomb Topology & 3 Elimination Axes
Axis 1: Horizontal (s-axis) Axis 2: 60° Left-Diagonal (q-axis) Axis 3: 120° Right-Diagonal (r-axis) Crossroads Hub: Center Node
Cube coordinates naturally generate the three independent linear axes of elimination: 1. **The $q$-Axis (60° Left-Diagonal)**: Lines defined by $q = c$, providing $2R + 1 = 9$ discrete clearing tracks. 2. **The $r$-Axis (120° Right-Diagonal)**: Lines defined by $r = c$, providing 9 discrete tracks. 3. **The $s$-Axis (0° Horizontal)**: Lines defined by $s = c$, providing 9 discrete tracks. - **Track Length Dynamics**: Outer perimeter lines span 5 cells, while the three diametric lines passing through the origin $(0, 0, 0)$ span 9 cells each. - **The Center Extremum Theorem**: The central cell $(0, 0, 0)$ is the sole coordinate shared simultaneously by all three 9-cell diametric axes. Securing or congesting the center directly governs the global health of the entire playfield. --- ## Chapter 2: Polyhex Staging Topology & The Rotation-Lock Constraint ### 2.1 The Purpose of Fixed Piece Orientation Beginners often ask: *Why doesn't the game permit piece rotation?* - In orthogonal games, rotation is necessary because 2-axis grids offer limited matching angles. - In a 3-axis hexagonal lattice, allowing rotation trivializes spatial constraints: players could effortlessly align awkward shapes to whichever axis is most convenient, destroying 80% of tactical depth. - **Fixed orientation** demands true macro planning: players must adapt their board topography to the rigid orientations of incoming polyhexes. ### 2.2 Polyhex Piece Taxonomy & Hazard Rating (Tier List) 1. **Tier S (Universal Fluidity & Rescue)**: - **Monochex (Single Cell)**: The supreme tactical asset. Can bridge any isolated gap or trigger crucial last-gasp line clears without space overhead. - **Di-hex (2-Cell Bar)**: High flexibility across both horizontal and diagonal planes. 2. **Tier A (Axis Clearing Penetrators)**: - **3-Bars & 4-Bars**: Precision weapons capable of completing an entire track in a single placement. High reward, but dangerous if the board lacks longitudinal runway. 3. **Tier B (Boundary Brackets)**: - **V-Shapes & Obtuse Angle Braces**: Straddle two intersecting axes; best anchored along exterior perimeters. 4. **Tier C (The Board Killers - High Threat)**: - **Triangles (3-cell or 6-cell clusters)** and **Dense Rhombuses**: Enormous footprint and zero concavity. If the center of the board lacks continuous open terrain, these pieces will instantly precipitate Game Over. --- ## Chapter 3: The Four Axioms of Hexa Space Management ### 3.1 Axiom 1: The Sacred Center Rule **The central 7-cell cluster must remain permanently fluid and breathable.** - Novice players intuitively place large pieces directly in the center of the board because it feels "safe." This is the single most destructive mistake in Hexa. - Parking a massive shape in the center fractures all three 9-cell diameter tracks simultaneously, reducing the board into fragmented, disconnected outer pockets. - The center should only be populated when it serves as the instantaneous catalyst for an immediate multiline clear. ### 3.2 Axiom 2: Perimeter Anchoring & Pocket Prevention - **Edge Alignment**: Always gravitate awkward triangles, angles, and long bars toward the 6 outer perimeter walls. - **Convex Integrity**: Match shapes flush against existing walls to prevent creating single-cell blind pockets surrounded on five sides. ### 3.3 Axiom 3: The Three-Piece Lookahead Principle **Never evaluate a piece in isolation!** - Before committing your first piece, inspect all 3 staged pieces in the lower tray: 1. Identify the largest, most unwieldy shape (the "Threat Shape"). 2. Locate an existing pocket capable of holding that Threat Shape. 3. Ensure your first two placements do not inadvertently disrupt that pocket! ### 3.4 Axiom 4: The Space Buffer Threshold - When total occupied cells exceed **42 cells (70% capacity)**, enter emergency mode. - Abandon all ambitions of staging fancy 3-line or 4-line combos; clear single lines immediately until capacity drops below 30 cells. --- ## Chapter 4: Multi-Line Clears & The Architecture of Crossroads ### 4.1 Super-Linear Scoring Dynamics The scoring engine in Puzzle PK utilizes super-linear exponential scaling: - 1 Line Clear: 100 points - 2 Lines Clear: 350 points (3.5× base value) - 3 Lines Clear: 900 points (9.0× base value) - 4 Lines Clear: 2,000 points (20.0× base value!) - 5+ Lines Clear: 3,500+ points **A single 4-line simultaneous clear awards more raw points than twenty individual 1-line clears combined.** ### 4.2 Engineering the Triple-Axis Crossroads To execute devastating multiline clears, master players systematically cultivate **Intersection Crossroads**: 1. Select a convergence node $(q_0, r_0, s_0)$, such as the center $(0, 0, 0)$. 2. Fill the horizontal track ($s$-axis) until only the node remains empty. 3. Simultaneously fill the left-diagonal ($q$-axis) and right-diagonal ($r$-axis) up to the threshold. 4. Drop a single piece into the intersection: all three axes clear simultaneously in a glorious 900-point explosion! --- ## Chapter 5: Combo Chains & Flow Momentum ### 5.1 Combo Multiplier Formula Maintaining consecutive clears across sequential placements activates the Combo Multiplier: $$\text{Multiplier}(K) = 1 + (K - 1) \times 0.5$$ - Combo 1: $1.0\times$ - Combo 2: $1.5\times$ - Combo 3: $2.0\times$ - Combo 4: $2.5\times$ - Combo 5+: $3.0\times \sim 5.0\times$! Executing a 2-line clear on Combo 4 yields $350 \times 2.5 = 875$ points on a single move. ### 5.2 The Staggered Reservoir Method - Do not clear every ready line at once. - Stagger your lines so that each placement in your 3-piece turn resolves exactly one line, chaining your combo across multiple turns while keeping the board spacious. --- ## Chapter 6: Multiplayer Real-Time PvP Survival Tactics ### 6.1 Deterministic RNG & Symmetrical Fair Play In Puzzle PK's competitive arena, all matched players receive the **exact same pseudo-random piece sequence**. There is zero RNG bias: both competitors face identical challenges. ### 6.2 Match Tempo & Tactical Composure 1. **Early Blitz**: Open with aggressive double/triple clears in the first 20 moves to establish a commanding 3,000-point lead. 2. **Endgame Endurance**: When the board inevitably tightens, shift focus from high-risk combo engineering to pure survival. The player who survives one round longer takes the match win. --- ## Chapter 7: Frequently Asked Questions & Master Tips (FAQ) ### Q1: How does the touchscreen offset work? Puzzle PK implements a custom **Touch Parallax Offset algorithm**. When dragging on mobile devices, the piece renders elevated 35px above your finger contact point so your thumb never obstructs the destination cells. Align via the translucent ghost outline and release. ### Q2: Why didn't my line clear when it looked full? A line must extend **100% from one outer edge of the board to the opposing outer edge** (between 5 and 9 contiguous hexes). If a single corner or edge hex is empty, the axis is incomplete. ### Q3: Is an "All Clear" achievable? Yes! Wiping all 61 cells completely clean triggers an **All Clear** achievement, awarding an immediate **+1,500 points** bonus. ### Q4: How do I break the 15,000-point threshold? - Keep the center 7 cells clear at all costs. - Never place pieces blindly; plan the destination of all 3 tray pieces before moving the first. - Prioritize double-line clears over single lines and sustain 4+ combo chains.","es":"# Guía Definitiva de Hexa Puzzle: Geometría de Panal y Estrategia Maestra Bienvenido a la guía oficial de **Hexa Puzzle (Eliminación Hexagonal)** en Puzzle PK. Este juego trasciende los rompecabezas clásicos al incorporar la geometría isotrópica del panal de abejas y **3 ejes de eliminación simultáneos**. ## Capítulo 1: Geometría Hexagonal y Coordenadas Cúbicas - **El Tablero de 61 Casillas**: Construido con radio $R=4$, posee exactamente 61 hexágonos ($1 + 3R(R+1)$). - **Tres Ejes de Eliminación**: A diferencia de los 2 ejes ortogonales clásicos, aquí disponemos de 27 líneas en 3 direcciones (horizontal, diagonal izquierda 60° y diagonal derecha 120°). - **El Centro Sagrado**: La casilla central $(0,0,0)$ pertenece a las 3 líneas más largas (9 casillas). Mantenerla despejada es vital. ## Capítulo 2: Las Cuatro Reglas de Oro del Espacio 1. **El Centro Sagrado**: Nunca coloque bloques masivos en el centro; romperán los 3 ejes simultáneamente. 2. **Anclaje Perimetral**: Empuje triángulos grandes y piezas en L hacia los 6 bordes exteriores. 3. **Visión de Tres Piezas**: Examine siempre las 3 piezas disponibles antes de mover la primera. 4. **Umbral de Alerta**: Cuando el tablero supere el 70% de ocupación, abandone los combos y limpie líneas individuales para sobrevivir. ## Capítulo 3: Puntuación Exponencial y Duelos PK - **Líneas Múltiples**: 1 línea = 100 pts, 2 líneas = 350 pts, 3 líneas = 900 pts, 4 líneas = 2.000 pts. - **Multiplicadores de Combo**: +0.5x por cada eliminación consecutiva. - **Fair Play en Duelos**: Ambos rivales reciben exactamente la misma secuencia de fichas.","ja":"# 六角形パズル（Hexa Puzzle）完全攻略ガイド：ハニカム幾何学と多次元ライン消去マスタークラス Puzzle PKがお届けする**六角形パズル（Hexa Puzzle）**の公式マスターガイドです。四角形グリッドの限界を突破したハニカム格子（正六角形タイリング）における**3軸同時消去**の極意を徹底解説します。 ## 第1章：ハニカム幾何学と3次元立方体座標系 - **全61マスの正六角形ボード**：半径 $R=4$ の構造で、総マス数は $1 + 3 \times 4 \times 5 = 61$ 個。 - **3つの消去軸（全27ライン）**：水平軸、左斜め60°軸、右斜め120°軸が交差します。 - **中央マス $(0, 0, 0)$ の重要性**：全ボード中で唯一、最も長い9マスライン3本が交わる最重要ハブです。 ## 第2章：空間管理の4大公理 1. **中央聖域の法則**：中央の7マスには決して巨大ブロックを置かず、常に風通しを良く保つこと。 2. **外周密着の法則**：大きな三角ピースや折れ線ピースは6つの外周に寄せて配置し、内側に孤立した窪みを作らない。 3. **3ピース先読みの法則**：最初の1手を置く前に、必ず手持ちの3ピースすべてを確認し、最大のピースの置き場を確保する。 4. **危険域バッファ**：盤面が70%以上埋まったらコンボ狙いを即座に中止し、単ライン消去で生存を最優先する。 ## 第3章：指数関数的スコアとリアルタイムPK対戦 - **多ライン同時消去**：1ライン=100点、2ライン=350点、3ライン=900点、4ライン=2,000点。 - **完全共通シード対戦**：PKアリーナでは対戦相手と全く同じピース順序が供給される完全実力勝負です。","ko":"# 헥사 퍼즐 (Hexa Puzzle) 궁극의 공략: 벌집 기하학 및 3축 다차원 클리어 가이드 Puzzle PK의 **헥사 퍼즐 (Hexa Puzzle)** 공식 마스터 가이드입니다. 2차원 사각 격자를 벗어나 정육각형 타일링의 등방성 대칭과 **3방향 동시 제거 축**의 심오한 수학적 전략을 분석합니다. ## 제1장: 벌집 기하학과 3축 제거 좌표계 - **61셀의 정육각형 보드**: 반지름 $R=4$ 기준, 총 $1 + 3(4)(5) = 61$개의 육각 셀로 구성됩니다. - **3대 제거 축 (총 27개 라인)**: 수평(0°), 좌측 대각(60°), 우측 대각(120°) 축으로 구성됩니다. - **중앙 핵심점의 원리**: 정중앙 $(0,0,0)$ 셀은 가장 긴 9셀짜리 3개 축이 모두 교차하는 핵심 관문입니다. ## 제2장: 공간 관리의 4대 공리 1. **중앙 보호의 법칙**: 중앙에 큰 블록을 두면 3개 축이 동시에 마비됩니다. 중앙은 항상 개방해 두어야 합니다. 2. **외곽 밀착의 법칙**: 거대한 삼각형 및 꺾인 블록은 보드의 6개 외곽 모서리에 맞춰 채워 넣습니다. 3. **3개 블록 전체 예측**: 첫 블록을 놓기 전, 주어지는 3개 블록 중 가장 거대한 블록의 안착 위치를 먼저 계산합니다. 4. **생존 버퍼 한계선**: 보드가 70% 이상 차오르면 콤보 욕심을 버리고 즉시 1줄씩 제거해 공간을 확보합니다. ## 제3장: 폭발적인 점수 획득과 실시간 PK 생존전 - **다중 라인 동시 클리어 점수**: 1줄 100점, 2줄 동시 350점, 3줄 동시 900점, 4줄 동시 2,000점! - **연속 콤보 배율**: 매 턴 연속 제거 시마다 배율 +0.5x씩 폭증 (최대 5.0x). - **공정 경쟁 PK**: 방 안의 모든 플레이어가 동일한 난수 시드로 완전히 동일한 블록 시퀀스를 플레이합니다.","pt":"# Guia Definitivo do Hexa Puzzle: Geometria em Colmeia e Estratégia de 3 Eixos Descubra o guia mestre oficial do **Hexa Puzzle** no Puzzle PK. Domine a geometria de 61 hexágonos com 3 eixos simultâneos de eliminação. ## Capítulo 1: Geometria do Tabuleiro e Eixos - Tabuleiro de 61 células ($R=4$) com 27 linhas possíveis em 3 direções (horizontal e duas diagonais a 60°/120°). - O centro $(0,0,0)$ é o nó mais valioso do jogo e deve ser preservado. ## Capítulo 2: As 4 Regras de Ouro 1. **Preserve o Centro**: Nunca coloque triângulos gigantes no coração do tabuleiro. 2. **Ancoragem nas Bordas**: Alinhe peças grandes ao longo das 6 paredes externas. 3. **Previsão das 3 Peças**: Planeje a posição da peça mais difícil antes de mover a primeira. 4. **Limite de Sobrevivência**: Se o tabuleiro estiver 70% ocupado, limpe linhas simples imediatamente. ## Capítulo 3: Pontuação e Duelos PK - Eliminações Múltiplas: 1 linha = 100 pts, 2 linhas = 350 pts, 3 linhas = 900 pts, 4 linhas = 2000 pts. - Combos sucessivos multiplicam sua pontuação (+0.5x por rodada). - No modo PK multiplayer, todos recebem as mesmas peças sob o mesmo gerador randômico.","fr":"# Guide Ultime de Hexa Puzzle : Géométrie en Nid d'Abeille et Élimination Tri-Axiale Bienvenue sur le guide expert officiel de **Hexa Puzzle** sur Puzzle PK. Apprenez à dominer le plateau de 61 cases à travers ses 3 axes d'élimination géométriques. ## Chapitre 1 : Géométrie et Coordonnées Cubiques - Plateau de 61 hexagones ($R=4$) proposant 27 lignes de destruction sur 3 axes (0°, 60°, 120°). - Le centre $(0,0,0)$ est l'intersection majeure des trois axes de 9 cases : il doit rester dégagé. ## Chapitre 2 : Les 4 Axiomes de Survie 1. **Sanctuaire Central** : Ne placez jamais de gros triangles au centre sous peine de bloquer tout le plateau. 2. **Ancrage Périphérique** : Alignez les grandes pièces contre les 6 bordures extérieures. 3. **Anticipation des 3 Pièces** : Trouvez toujours l'emplacement de la pièce la plus imposante avant de jouer la première. 4. **Seuil de Danger** : Au-delà de 70 % de remplissage, éliminez sans attendre la moindre ligne disponible. ## Chapitre 3 : Score Exponentiel et Duels PK - Lignes simultanées : 1 ligne = 100 pts, 2 lignes = 350 pts, 3 lignes = 900 pts, 4 lignes = 2000 pts. - Système de combo consécutif (+0.5x par coup gagnant). - Compétition PK équitable avec graine aléatoire identique pour tous les joueurs.","de":"# Ultimativer Leitfaden für Hexa Puzzle: Wabengeometrie & 3-Achsen-Abbau Willkommen zum offiziellen Meisterleitfaden für **Hexa Puzzle** auf Puzzle PK. Meistern Sie das 61-Felder-Wabenbrett mit seinen 3 gleichberechtigten Abbau-Achsen. ## Kapitel 1: Wabengeometrie und Koordinaten - Wabenbrett mit 61 Feldern ($R=4$) und 27 Abbau-Linien in 3 Dimensionen (horizontal, 60° und 120°). - Das Zentrum $(0,0,0)$ verbindet alle drei 9er-Hauptachsen und muss stets flexibel bleiben. ## Kapitel 2: Die 4 Axiome des Raummanagements 1. **Das unantastbare Zentrum**: Platzieren Sie niemals klobige Blöcke mitten im Feld. 2. **Kanten-Verankerung**: Schieben Sie sperrige Dreiecke an die 6 Außenkanten. 3. **Drei-Teile-Vorausschau**: Bestimmen Sie den Platz für das schwierigste Teil, bevor Sie das erste ablegen. 4. **Gefahrenschwelle**: Brechen Sie bei über 70 % Füllung Kombos ab und räumen Sie sofort Einzellinien ab. ## Kapitel 3: Exponentielle Punkte & Mehrspieler-PK - Mehrfach-Linien: 1 Linie = 100 Pkt, 2 Linien = 350 Pkt, 3 Linien = 900 Pkt, 4 Linien = 2000 Pkt. - Fortlaufende Combo-Multiplikatoren (+0.5x pro Zug). - Absolut faire PK-Duelle durch identische Zufallsfolgen für alle Spieler."}
